zero_point.source: TESS Instrument Handbook v0.1 (Dec 2018): a T = 10 star gives about 15,000 e-/s (zero point 20.44), 'confirmed to a few percent' in flight; T is Vega-based with T(Vega) = 0 by definition (Sullivan et al. 2015, ApJ 809, 77, Sect. 2.2)
zero_point.empirical_source: Handberg et al. 2021, Sect. 8: aperture photometry on calibrated FFIs of sectors 1-6, zp 20.401-20.506 (mean 20.451)
